Routines for the rewarding block
The purpose of this section is to describe the plain rules
Companion Animal Travel Desk

Aurelia Skyways keeps companion animal travel on a controlled path so passengers, pets, and crews move with fewer delays and less confusion. Staff must review each request as a shared responsibility and keep the record clean, complete, and current. <<FACT F091>> Booking cannot proceed until the file shows the travel route, animal details, carrier details, and any required acceptance notes. When a booking is approved, the agent records the passenger contact point, checks that the animal fits the approved carriage standard, and confirms any handling needs that affect the journey.

The desk accepts only clear and lawful travel requests. Staff must not promise acceptance before the review is done, and they must not add special handling that has not been checked. If a passenger arrives with a pet that differs from the submitted details, the agent pauses the process and sends the case back for review. The senior coordinator may request extra documents when the route, animal type, or airport rules call for closer control. If an animal needs separation from other cabin flow, staff use the assigned holding area and keep the passenger informed in plain language.

All notes must stay accurate, brief, and factual. If a reservation changes, the desk updates the file at once and confirms any new limits before travel day. Staff should treat every companion animal with steady care, and they must report any welfare concern without delay. For unresolved cases, contact the senior coordinator or the duty manager at Aurelia Skyways.
